description:
Build a terminal rendering backend for Filament in octo_pi, to be pushed upstream once the design is proven.

## Motivation

Filament currently targets web (HTML/LiveView). The octo_pi TUI needs the same reactive component model — fiber trees, cells, hooks, event dispatch — but painting terminal output instead of HTML. Building it here first lets us iterate on the API without coupling to the upstream release cycle.

## Scope

- `Filament.TUI.Backend` behaviour: takes a walked VNode tree and produces terminal output (ANSI escape sequences / VLines)
- VNode-to-terminal mapping: {:element, tag, attrs, children} drives layout (box model, flex direction, width/height)
- Integration with existing octo_pi VDOM primitives (VLines, Paint) as the initial paint layer
- Reconciler loop: diffs fiber tree between renders, applies minimal terminal updates
- Event routing: map terminal key/mouse events to Filament's capture/bubble dispatch

## Relationship to Existing TUI

The current octo_pi_tui app uses a hand-rolled VDOM (VLines + Paint). This backend would power a parallel `octo_pi_tui2` app built on Filament components, eventually replacing the hand-rolled layer.

## Upstream Path

Once the design is stable and the screen template pattern (opi-lzr) is validated end-to-end, extract Filament.TUI into the upstream Filament repository as an optional backend package.
title: Filament.TUI: terminal rendering backend (octo_pi prototype)
